title: Shalmaneser III’s last campaign, against Cilicia
summary: Shalmaneser III’s final campaign in the west, against Cilicia.
description: Shalmaneser III’s final campaign in the west, against Cilicia. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (section “The Tell al-Rimah Stela”, p. 15).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 830 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “The Tell al-Rimah Stela”, p. 15
chronologies.note: Shalmaneser III’s final campaign. His son Ashur-danin-pal (Sardanapallus) then revolts, beginning a four-year civil war.
